root_cause: The single failing test, test_keras_lstm_flags_float32, builds a Keras LSTM with dropout (0.1, 0.3) enabled during the forward pass used to produce the TensorFlow reference output. Because dropout relies on TensorFlow's internal RNG and is re-seeded differently per process/run, the TF reference output and the OpenVINO-converted (dropout-free, since dropout is a no-op at inference) output diverge beyond the fixed FP32 comparison tolerance (max diff 0.2137 vs eps 1e-4/5e-2) whenever the random dropout mask happens to produce a reference activation far from the deterministic inference path. This is the same signature previously recorded on 2026-10-16 (pattern da5b0923c1cd0777, first seen with max diff ~0.07), confirming a recurring, non-deterministic test rather than a regression. The triggering commit (#39978, 'GQA: detect V2 by u2 weights before position_ids') only touches NPUW GQA case-identification logic in the NPU plugin and has no code path connection to the TensorFlow frontend or Keras LSTM translation/inference.
reproduction_steps: cd install/tests/layer_tests (or src/frontends/tensorflow/tests layer_tests) and run: `python -m pytest tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_lstm.py::TestKerasLSTM::test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 -k flags_float32 --ie_device=CPU -v` repeatedly; failure depends on TensorFlow's random dropout mask seeding each run and is not guaranteed to reproduce on the first try.
recommended_actions: Fix or remove the random seed used for Dropout layers in create_keras_lstm_net (tensorflow2_keras_tests/test_tf2_keras_lstm.py) so TF reference generation is deterministic across runs, or disable dropout entirely for inference-equivalence tests.

Consider widening the comparison tolerance or skipping dropout-enabled test_data_different_flags parametrizations in test_keras_lstm_flags_float32 since dropout has no effect at inference time and should not meaningfully diverge between frameworks.
Re-run the TensorFlow Layer Tests job for this commit to confirm the failure is transient and unrelated to PR #39978 before treating it as a regression blocking master.
prevention_strategies: Set a fixed random seed (numpy/tensorflow) before generating Keras LSTM test models that use Dropout, or generate the framework reference output using the same forward pass configuration (training=False) that OpenVINO's converted graph uses, so dropout masks never influence the reference comparison. Track recurrence count via pattern da5b0923c1cd0777 and escalate to the TensorFlow Frontend layer-test owners if it keeps recurring.
historical_context: This exact signature was first recorded on 2026-10-16 (run 38942875639, pattern da5b0923c1cd0777) with a smaller max diff (~0.07); this occurrence raises max diff to 0.2137, confirming the instability is driven by dropout randomness rather than a fixed numeric offset. No code change has been made to date; categorized consistently as Flaky Test across both occurrences.
